name: hanekawa

scripts.build:desktop: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/desktop/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node24 --outfile=dist/desktop/preload.js --external:electron && esbuild src/desktop/renderer/app.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --format=esm --target=chrome156 --main-fields= --alias:node:crypto=./src/desktop/renderer/runtime/nodeCryptoShim.ts --outfile=dist/desktop/renderer/app.js && esbuild src/desktop/renderer/themeBoot.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=chrome156 --outfile=dist/desktop/renderer/theme-boot.js && node scripts/copy-desktop-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.domtest.json
scripts.pack:mac: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never

description: Self-hosted coding agent with an Electron desktop app
author: lyutianjian
